exposure: Preeclampsia vs. non-preeclampsia within each Robson group
cohort: Women who delivered in a referral maternity hospital in southeast Brazil (n=3102)
finding: Preeclampsia was associated with a higher occurrence of cesarean delivery, particularly in Robson groups 1, 5, and 10.
mod_finding: Pre-eclampsia was associated with a higher occurrence of cesarean delivery.
